reviews.title: I’ve used this app for years, but it seems to have fallen off a bit lately.
reviews.text: First of all I really love the interface. It's a great way for me to visualize the different factors that go into my physical health. However, I have noticed lately that the nutrition database is really buggy and limited. It frequently returns “no results” when I know there should be at least one result (because I added it myself). The barcode scanner almost never works for me anymore when it used to be my go-to for adding food items. The team also seems to really be phoning in the patch notes in their updates. For example, for the past eight monthly releases, every release seems to have added “new steps and challenge widgets and bug fixes and performance improvements for smoother operations” without anything else since December 2025. And before that they “refreshed the user interface for a cleaner, more modern look” in each of the 3 previous releases in 2025. Don’t get me wrong I like the app and use it a lot, I’m just kind of expecting a bit more at this point.

reviews.title: Since 2016 daily used
reviews.text: This million dollar app is so good it should be picked up by Apple and offered for free on every iPhone users dashboard. Argus invested deep pocket money to make this app simply sensational. Sleep tracking with heart rate monitoring. Wake up to world wide friends and have social support. Become 10% happier by being genuinely glad for their success. Why, because you actually see those friends post every day for years. You see some people use exercise, others runners, so much variety. The tile dashboard leads you through next steps throughout the day. Your health is one step at a time. You can picture without limitation everything about yourself. That's accountability. You then can comment how it makes you feel. The app has a rich resource of tracking prior results in its reports feature. Learn if your perceptions about yourself are really true. Compare the effect of one activity on another aspect. Day you wanted to find out if meditation effected heart rate. You will be motivated to actually see good days, struggle days in pictures. You will have an Argus family who sticks with this app for multi years. Thats the oregano factor.

With my new Apple Watch, the SE 2 if I tap the screen the walk pauses and if I tap it again it resumes. The other options are gone! Now I have to end the walk on my iPhone. How do I get those options back?!

reviews.title: Can’t Sync FitBit to Argus Anymore!😟
reviews.text:
09/01/2024 - I posted this review a few months ago,  and I’m still not able to sync my Fitbit to Argus.  So I’m taking away 2 stars.  I thought about switching to Garmin, but that would mean buying another device which I don’t want incur another cost. Plus, I checked on syncing a Garmin device in the Argus app, and I got an error message for that, too! If your not going to correct the issue, please let us know.  Thanks. 

Previous Review: 
I used to be able to sync my steps in Fitbit to Argus, but for some reason it stopped working in December 2023. I have email Argus—but no response. It’s still showing up in my app as a device that can be synce, but every time I try to reconnect I get this error message that Argus did not provide valid information to Fitbit and to please report the issue to Argus. If you’re not going to fix the problem, please remove Fitbit from the list of devices that can be synced. This is misleading, and it was a great benefit when it worked since I wear my Fitbit more than I carry my phone with me. Now I’m underreporting my actual steps in Argus every day! This is making me think twice about renewing my premium subscription. It worked before, so I assume this should be an easy fix.
